title: Reuse encoded Gaussian kernel setup through actual protected Core pages
body:
PR3851 rebuilds its Axis and old truncated-kernel inverses for each protected Gaussian page. This package adds a persistent fixed-bank owner that retains one genuine Axis and one encoded inverse entry, emits the unchanged structured page, and feeds actual `Core.run`. The private key is interior length under an immutable session kernel and bandwidth; it is not a cache for arbitrary same-size matrices.

A miss pays the original encoded inverse and a resident Matrix clone. A hit pays a full independent serialized clone. Eviction, lookup, every unchanged Schur/LU/factor operation, page copy/consumption, Core/halo calls, final disposal and retained high-water backing remain explicit in the proof's complete profile. The source inverse allowance is charged only at misses; an O((k+1)^8(P+log(k+1))^3) copying allowance is charged at every request. There is no unconditional short-stream speedup or complete supplier-budget claim.

Actual source evidence uses axis(13,14,1,1), work24/target16. A real miss and hit produce identical protected page and nonzero Core output bytes, with154 inherited base-word calls each. A third actual page exercises changed-length eviction. Resident numerical corruption changes the page; pending-page and negative-alias controls protect the owner boundary; all1024 scratch tapes plus page output finish blank with restored heads and erased markers. Retained owner backing is78,831 tape cells in this fixture; peak147 leases. These finite measurements corroborate the written contract and do not replace its proof.

Validation: normal actual-owner generation and optimized Git-free read-only replay pass (cold241.91s); ten cheap actual-class alias cases pass normal/optimized. MissingSOURCES, missingRESULT, actual frozen source-byte corruption and typed integer-to-float receipt controls reject; restored export bytes exactly match the official archive. Metadata/pins, committed-byte/source-history checks and official export integrity pass. Independent source/proof review resolved a real alias guard-order issue before the final runs. The registered full wrapper was not repeated on top of those exact commands.

Package `research/gaussian-encoded-kernel-session`; base `a5df48c55ea806d7952b65acc9c76d878ff09b13`. [Canonical claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4202#discussioncomment-19144826). Credit Jose Manuel's PR3851 and its retained word/interval/factorization sources, Dugongue's PR3872 cache precedent and Nick Petalas's distinct PR5119 barrier. Frozen source files and archives remain unchanged. JoyboyBrian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

Production-sized grids, the third page's Core call, the enclosing tensor/catalogue/halo/CRT caller and a new literal finite-instruction compilation remain unrun. Original approximation and word-arithmetic premises remain inherited. No selected-frontier change, lower working precision, full multiplication theorem or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.


Hosted replay budget follow-up: CI on Ubuntu24.04 CPython3.12.15 timed out at the exact360-second normal replay after both guard checks passed. This metadata-only change raises normal and optimized caps to585 seconds each, preserving15-second guard caps and1200-second total. Scientific code, proof, receipts and pinned sources are unchanged. The exact follow-up head `6b985d37efd6211f2fcfcdf523ce0a8426c4fb93` subsequently passed the complete registered Linux package replay and unchanged-input check on Ubuntu24.04 CPython3.12.15: [job120426206087](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39956636608/job/120426206087), completed2026-10-23T13:08:08Z. No additional local scientific replay was run for this metadata change.
